svg.title: Corrections — gold rocker
svg.desc: The geometry is standardized to its shared construction master, removing photographic perspective/crop distortion. Readable source wording and colour edition are retained. Exact embroidered alphabet, thread colour and fine heraldic detail remain unverified.
